candidates.name: Coordinate transformations
verified_facts: OS identifies ETRS89 as the GNSS reference frame used in Great Britain and OSGB36 National Grid/ODN as national mapping and height systems.
OSTN15 and OSGM15 link GNSS 3D positions to OSGB36 National Grid and mean-sea-level based heights.
semantic_limits: Correct reference-system transformation preserves coordinate lineage but does not certify LiDAR sensor, raster sampling or parcel-boundary accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Net & GNSS questions and answers
verified_facts: OS Net operates in ETRS89 and station coordinates are included in RINEX headers.
OS states OSTN15 and OSGM15 are used to transform OS Net ETRS89 positions to National Grid coordinates and ODN heights, using more than 2.6 million transformation parameters.
semantic_limits: Transformation-model complexity or RINEX coordinate availability cannot be assigned directly as parcel elevation confidence or used to cancel raster uncertainty.
